lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ce8Si4Te20 (Ce2SiTe5) crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6_3/mmc (No. 194), with 32 atoms per unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ce centers with a close-packed-like local arrangement of 12 geometric neighbors (8 Te and 4 Si), while Si adopts an octahedral environment of 6 Te neighbors. Te centers display 5- and 9-vertex coordination, and Si–Te polyhedra show corner- and edge-sharing. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component spanning all 32 sites.
